text: Total Annihilation is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating Vexiona in Ny'alotha, the Waking City after allowing every player to be hit by Annihilation at least 30 times.
Tormentor's Spiked Noose is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Tormented Soul Remnants are souls of various races found in Soul Cages inside Torghast. Open the cage to free them, and in return they will add a stack of Soul Remnant's Blessing, gaining 1% agility/intellect/strength for the remainder of the run.

Tormented Tanya is an ash ghoul located in Sinfall near the flight master Courier Snaggle and the gargon Vrednic. She says one of four possible gossip texts when you interact with her, talking about the Light's invasion of the Ember Ward, her involvement in why that happened, and time.
Tortured Fleshbeast Cuirass drops from the Carapace of N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
The Torn Scroll of Unearthly Rituals drops from the Sleepless Interrogator at Blackrock Mountain.
Tormented Hero: Shadowlands Season 2 is a feat of strength achievement earned by ending Shadowlands Mythic+ Season 2 with a Mythic+ Rating in the top 0.1% for your faction.
__NOTOC__ Tormented Tomb-Robbers are skeletons located in the Chamber of the Stars in Uldum.

The Tormented Trinket is a reward from Scared of the Dark. It will create one of the following rare trinkets, depending on your class and specialization. *Tormented Emblem of Flame *Tormented Fang of Gore *Tormented Insignia of Dreams *Tormented Seal of Fortitude *Tormented Tooth of Ferocity
The Tormented Tooth of Ferocity is created through the use of a Tormented Trinket.
Totem of Wrath is a shaman Totem that grants bonus spell power and critical strike chance to party and raid members.

A totemic druid is a druid that bases his magic off a single totem. Before and during the Third War, almost all druids were night elves. (Most are still night elves, though many tauren and a few other races now take up the path.) Night elf druids were organized into different subgroups, each with its own totem animal — the most famous, and most influential in the Third War, were the Druids of the Claw and the Druids of the Talon. Since the war, night elves (and other druids) realized that diversity might be a better option. Now, druids no longer organize themselves by totem, but instead incorporate many different animals and animalistic aspects into their repertoire. Some call themselves Dru
Totem of Living Water can be purchased for from in Shattrath City.

Totem Twisting no longer functions due to changes in patch 3.0 Totem Twisting was once a strategy employed by a Shaman in order to allow his group to benefit from two totems from the same magic school at once. It is principally used with Windfury Totem and Grace of Air Totem, although conceivably it could be used to with Flametongue Totem and Totem of Wrath. The idea behind totem twisting was that, since Windfury Totem periodically applies a 9 second weapon buff, another totem can be dropped within the 9 second intervals. For example: * Shaman drops Windfury Totem and notices the weapon buff has been applied. * Shaman drops Grace of Air Totem. Now group members are under the effects of both

Totem of Tortolla is provided as an objective for Finish Nemesis. With the power discovered by examining a Nemesis Crystal, a Child of Tortolla accompanying you provides protection against the fury of Nemesis.

The Totem of Akil'darah is a statue of an eagle spirit, named Akil'darah, found on the uppermost terrace of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. After completing the quest Death to the Vilebranch (Horde), Horde characters can interact with the totem to instantly teleport to Kotonga at the base of Jintha'Alor and vice versa, allowing faster access to quest objectives. __NOTOC__
Touch of the Animus is an ability used by Son of Animus during a Pet Battle.
Totemic Persistence is a passive talented shaman ability, available at level 45.
Tough n' Cuddly is an ability used by Alterac Brew-Pup during a Pet Battle.
Touch of the Abyss was available during the development stages of World of Warcraft: Legion, found in the Athenaeum at the Moon Guard Stronghold in Suramar. However, it was removed prior to release.
Touch the Stars was a Balance druid honor talent, available at rank 8.
Tottle is a baby tortollan companion. Obtaining this pet will reward the Collector's Edition: Tottle feat of strength.
Tour of Duty: Mechagon is a player vs. player achievement earned by earning 1000 honor on Mechagon Island while in War Mode.
Totems of the Annual Cull are sold for by Moof during Island Expeditions.
Totemic Slam is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Touch of the Unseen is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tournament Gladiator's Emblem of Tenacity is sold by Pyxni Pennypocket in .
Tournament Gladiator's Medallion of Tenacity is sold by Pyxni Pennypocket in .
Totemic Ruins are obtained by destroying Owlkin Totems in the Hidden Grove in Winterspring.
Totem Toss was never made available. It has the same use effect as Display of Strength.
Track Undead is a hunter ability that displays any nearby Undead on your minimap.
Track Hidden is a Hunter ability that increases stealth detection and shows hidden units as points on the minimap.
Track Elementals is a hunter ability that displays any nearby Elementals on your minimap.
Track Demons is a hunter ability that causes all nearby Demons to appear on your minimap.
:"It um... it really wasn't all that hard to find him..." Track Giants is a hunter ability that displays any nearby Giants on your minimap.
Track Dragonkin is a hunter ability that displays any nearby Dragonkin on your minimap.

.]] Town halls (and city halls) serve as the primary centers for most human and Alliance towns. However, town halls have also been used by other races in the past and present, including high and blood elves, and the Forsaken. As the size of the town increases, the town hall can be upgraded into a keep or castle.

The Trader's Tier is the area of the Exodar containing most of the trainers and vendors. This area houses various non-magic craftsmen and merchants, and also the Guild Master and tabard seller. Scattered around the floor are engineering, mining, blacksmith, skinning, leatherworking, and tailoring trainers, as well as Dugiru the Alliance Cloth Quartermaster. Slightly up the stairs is the Hunter's Sanctum, with hunter trainers, and at the top of the ramp is a circular platform called the Ring of Arms with warrior and monk trainers and Handiir the weapon master. The naaru helped build the Exodar, and M'iri designed the Trader's Tier, shaping it to attract talented tradesfolk. There's also a mur
Trader Endernor is a level 60 trade goods vendor located on the Scryer's Tier in the neutral Shattrath City.

= Tips for trading = Many new players get quite a surprise the first time they enter a capital city, when they see all of the colorful item names that pop up when clicked in the chat window. For the newbie, it can be more than confusing to figure out what's in-demand, what's cheap, and how to make money. This guide isn't written completely NPOV, because it contains a lot of firsthand experience on how WoW economy is used and misused. Most newcomers to this market can literally be harassed by other players, get ripped off, or even made the laughingstock of the trade channel. I will call buying/selling in the Trade channel "the direct market" because it is different from Auction House in that

Trade Goods or Trade Supplies are basic items needed for professions or tradeskills. Vendors (trade supplier, tradesman, or tradeswoman) for these items can be found in just about every major city or village. Depending upon the specific vendor, they can sell a variety of tradeskill-related items, including ingredients, reagents, and tools. Generally, they are found nearby profession trainers, or sometimes are profession trainers themselves.
The Toxic Fogger is provided as an objective for The Flying Machine Airport.

The Trade Fleets are goblin fleets. They are mentioned, alongside their leader Vice Admiral Grezzlik, by Gazlowe saying that trade princes invested a lot of money into the Trade Fleets. They are also mentioned in the goblin intro cinematic. Trade Prince Maldy had a trade fleet until Jastor Gallywix tricked him into destroying it.
Track Humanoids is a Hunter ability that shows humanoids as points on the minimap.

The Tower of Life (also known as the tower of Freya) is a large destructible building that can be found the Iron Concourse in Ulduar. It contains the power to turn barren wastelands into jungles teeming with life overnight.
The Tower of Flames is a large destructible building that can be found the Iron Concourse in Ulduar. This generator powers Mimiron's Gaze, which in moments can turn earth to ash and stone to magma.

Trade Prince Maldy was the owner of the Bilgewater Cartel before Jastor Gallywix. He was overthrown by Gallywix twenty years prior to the Cataclysm, after Gallywix bought out Maldy's staff, his bodyguards, and his home, and destroyed his fleet of ships providing weapons for the Alliance. In total control of the Bilgewater Cartel, Gallywix exiled Maldy and his beloved daughter, Nessa, from Kezan. Gallywix later arranged Maldy's (supposedly accidental) death.

Town-In-A-Box is a goblin town that was literally spawned from a box. The town is located on the largest of the Lost Isles to the southwest. It is phased from the Landing Site to the town after your character sets off a large amount of explosives, breaking the container. It is interesting to note that the box shakes like there isn't enough room for the town before it opens. The Town-In-A-Box contained three houses, one poultryizer (for food), a forge, an anvil, a mailbox, a KTC Train-a-Tron Deluxe, a goblin barbecue, a "micro" mechachicken (also for food), and seemingly a generator for power, along with a control panel in the center of town. Trade Prince Gallywix had stolen the dock and oil
The Tower Point Warmaster guards Drek'Thar in Frostwolf Keep in Alterac Valley until Tower Point is destroyed.
The Trail of Devastation is a path created by the M.A.C. Diver when it drove from the Cursed Landing to the Tomb of the Sun King in Uldum.
The Tower Point Marshal guarded Vanndar Stormpike in the fortress of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley after Tower Point was destroyed.
Toxic Smoke is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Tracker Lang is a pandaren stable master located on the Golden Terrace of the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He is accompanied by his pet dragon turtle, Shelly.
Tower Plower is a player vs. player achievement earned for destroying a tower during a battle for Tol Barad.
Toxic Skin is an ability used by Gulp Froglet during a Pet Battle.
Toxicfang Venom is found at just outside Shattered Rise to the west in east-central Spires of Arak.
Toxic Umbrafen Herbs drop from Moonglow Sporebats and Umbraspore Giants in Umbrafen in .
The Trader's Camp is a small Alliance camp located in Drustvar. It includes a flight master and some members of the Maldus family.

Trader Haw'li is a Zandalari troll located in the Hot House in Dazar'alor. He is famous for his chili. When the traitorous prophet Zul and Mythrax attacked the city, Haw'li was cornered by the invading sethrak. He was rescued by the Speaker of the Horde and joined the fight alongside Princess Talanji. He was present during the funeral of King Rastakhan and the riots in the Zocalo during Talanji's coronation.

The Tradewinds Market is the northeastern district of the city of Boralus. It is part of Boralus Harbor and it is here that the Alliance's base of operations in Kul Tiras is found. Merchants are in the main circle while profession trainers are in a raised earthen area in the back.
Toxic Stinger drops from the following mobs in Deathmist Hills in Tiragarde Sound: *Marrowfly *Venomspine Saurolisk
__NOTOC__ Tradewinds Counting House is located in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. It is the main bank for the city. The bank doesn't offer overdraft protection.
Towne Gearknock is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Trader Udu is a pygmy who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Trade Prince Gallywix Hologram is a Jastor Gallywix's projection that briefly appears in Vigil Hill in Tiragarde Sound during Insurance Policy.
Toxic Bite is an ability used mainly by saurolisks during a Pet Battle.
Toxic Spray is an ability used by battle pets during a Pet Battle.
Toxinbelly Croakers are toads located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Tracker Vu'ka is a sand troll located in Island Expeditions.
Toxic Accumulator is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Toxic Onslaught is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Toxic Onslaught.
Tower Overwhelming is a feat of strength achievement earned by completing every challenge at the Mage Tower across all classes and specializations during the Legion Timewalking event.
Toxicity Strike Team is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the Toxic Swogmother after Purging the Water Intakes in Halls of Infusion on Mythic difficulty.

The Trading Post Post is pinned to a post at the Trading Posts at in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar. Trading Post Barkers are located in Valdrakken, in Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind City, and in Gates of Orgrimmar in Orgrimmar. They come in all playable races.
Toxic Sting is a special pet ability available exclusively to the Wasp family of hunter pets, reducing the effects of healing on the target by 50%.
The Toy Train Set is sold in Dalaran and Stormwind City for by: * * *

Tranquil Shore is a beach found across a mountain ridge, west of the West Sanctum. It is currently inhabited by Grimscale murlocs. On the hill to the east, Hathvelion Sungaze has set up a camp. He is determined to cleanse the beaches of Eversong Woods from the "murloc blight".
Tranquil Moonlight Wraps are epic leather gloves for balance druids.

Traitors! begins the Uldum storyline proper. However, it takes place in a phased copy of the Lost City of Tol'vir, so the breadcrumb Easy Money is in fact the actual start of Uldum. See that article for more information.

Training Targets are training dummies used in the first combat quest of newly-created pandaren. Found at the Shang Xi Training Grounds on the Wandering Isle, Master Shang Xi directs adventurers to destroy five Training Targets before continuing in their training.
Trample is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
The Tranquil Court is the southern half of Karabor, and is the location of the innkeeper and flight master.
__NOTOC__ A Transferable Vellum is a by-product of the Inscription skill-up item Faintly Magical Vellum.
The Translucent Shell is sold by at the Darkmoon Faire at a cost of . It summons a Ghostshell Crab.
Transfer the Power is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Tiger Claws and Inner Peace (artifact trait) traits.
Trainee Starwhisper is night elf flight master found at the Watchers' Aerie on the Isle of the Watchers in Azsuna.
Trained Brightlances are Lightforged draenei located at the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City. They can also be found at various locations in Ironforge and the Exodar.
Tranquil Wildkin Spirit is a moonkin ghost located in Darkshore.
Transcend the Flesh was the Necrolord Covenant signature ability shown at BlizzCon 2019. It was replaced with Fleshcraft by April 2020.
The Training Hall is located in the Old Town of Stormwind City. It is the repurposed Command Center.
Trained Jibberwings are hozen flying on bats located in Kun-Lai Summit.
The Translocation Agent is a broker located next to the Stormwind and Orgrimmar portals in Oribos. They offer training for the mage spells Teleport: Oribos and Portal: Oribos.
Trampleleaf the Jungle Quake is a boar located in Island Expeditions.

Transference Disc could be used to repair a Smashed Transport Relay with a Hyperbolic Circuit, and an Energy Cell, resulting in a Nullifier Transport Relay. The repaired item would then be used to summon the Mechagonian Nullifier at Junkwatt Depot on Mechagon Island.

When an MMORPG has large experience point requirements for each level (usually to keep players playing and paying), playing is said to feel like running on a treadmill and the time spent is seen as a "leveling treadmill". You spend a lot of time killing before you see any progress in levels. World of Warcraft has less of of a treadmill feel than a lot of other MMORPGs, though it is still there since characters can take a few weeks to a few months to level depending on how long the person plays and how much the person uses power leveling strategies.
Treants (or ents) are mighty tree-folk imbued with great wisdom and strength native to the forests of Azeroth. They are listed as elementals in World of Warcraft.

The Traveler's Backpack is a 16 slot bag. It is similar to the Backpack that all newly created characters start off with. It ties with the Mooncloth Bag as the largest bag that does not bind (either when picked up or when used).

Travel to Azure Watch is an Alliance-only quest from the draenei starting region Ammen Vale. It is the final quest starting in that region, and introduces new draenei to the larger part of the island by sending them on to the first real town, Azure Watch, outside the vale. Note that you will have to have completed most of the quests in Ammen Vale in order to get this one.

A traveler is a creature visiting the Emerald Dream either by dreams or by direct planar travel (if they are powerful enough). Furbolgs, naga, ogres, pandaren, quilboar, trolls, and other humanoids are commonly encountered travelers. A significant number of creatures can be found the plane that are merely dream visitors. Some of these creatures are present only for a single dream, while others appear frequently. Many cats, for example, cross into the Emerald Dream on a regular basis. While their bodies sleep, their twitching paws and quivering whiskers signify they are quite active once they cross between planes. Cats and other mammals are not the only living things to make the crossing. Any

Trap Mastery is a passive specialization ability for Survival hunters, available at level 64. It reduces the cooldown of all your traps by 6 seconds,and enhances your traps. This includes: Ice Trap,Freezing Trap,Explosive Trap, Black Arrow

Trapper Mau'i is a tuskarr of the Kalu'ak tribe located in Dragonblight. He can be found in the Moa'ki Harbor next to the inn entrance (across from the flight master). Trapper Mau'i is one of three quest givers for the Kalu'ak that will provide a daily quest after completing the prerequisite quest chain. The daily quest provides 500 reputation to the Kalu'ak (all the way to an exalted reputation). The chain starts with Let Nothing Go To Waste, continues with Slay Loguhn and ends with Planning for the Future.
Treads of Dependability is a quest reward from Not Entirely Unprepared.

A trap is a grounded object, often concealed, that produces an effect as an enemy comes within its range. The ability to set traps is a defining feature of the hunter class. Traps can also sometimes be found in the game environment, usually in instances. Rogues can locate traps with Detect Traps and disarm them with Disarm Trap.
Travist Bosk is a Forsaken found in the War Quarter of the Undercity. He is training along with Alyssa Blaye and Eldin Partridge, under the direction of Sergeant Houser.
The Trapper's Enclave is a subzone of the Lost City of Tol'vir.
Travis Nichols is a gnome coffee vendor that can be found in the Stormwind City Canals. He's standing just next to Kyle Radue and Chris Miller.

Traveling Pet Mauler is an account-wide Pet battles Battle achievement earned by winning a pet battle in 30 different zones on the Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor, Outland, Northrend, or Pandaria continents.

Form]] The Treant Form is a vanity druid form that is taught by Tome of the Wilds: Treant Form. Unlike the other druid forms, this one does not protect players from polymorph abilities or remove movement impairing effects.
Trap Superstar is an achievement earned from completing 500 work orders at the Barn in the garrison.

Treasure Goblins are small, mischievous creatures that can spawn throughout the Broken Isles as well as at the end of any Broken Isles dungeon during the course of the Diablo's 20th Anniversary world event. If attacked, they will attempt to run away, and if not killed in time they will open an Escape Portal and despawn. If they are successfully killed, they will drop various items. During the Diablo 20th Aniversary Event, they also caused another portal labeled "The Secret Cow Level" to open nearby. The latter can be used to teleport to a phased version of the Yorgen Farmstead in Duskwood inhabited by Diabolic Bovines, Diabolic Tauren and the Cow King. They also spawned during the A Greedy E

Travis Moreau is a human located in Stormsong Valley, atop the snowy mountains, north of Hatherford. He traveled to the Waking Shores, where he can be found along with Cynthia Cloudwhisper, Ku-Mo, and a jug of Slam Bam Swill in a tree in the Crumbling Cliffs.
Trapdoor Spiders are spiders encountered during Island Expeditions.
The Travel Journal is a flying tome that can be found in Glitterfall Basin or Glitterfall Heights in Ardenweald.

A Tree of Eternity is a tree of ages who has reached its full maturity. This is the highest level of growth, and the strongest possible bond with the World Tree and the Well of Eternity. At this point the night elf community is at its height, drawing freely from the tree's nearly unlimited power. These ancients suffered heavy losses during the Third War and returned to the forests to spread their seeds and replenish their numbers undisturbed.
Trident of the Outcast Tribe is an epic polearm that can be purchased from Nakodu for . You must also be with Lower City.

Trelleum Mine is the small shaft dug into the side of the floating island that Manaforge Ara sits upon. It is run by demons of the Burning Legion, and overseen by Kael'thas' blood elves. It is the sole supply of material for running the forges. It is run by Overmaster Grindgarr.

Trias' Cheese is a cheese shop located in the Trade District of Stormwind City. Here, the Trias family strives to be the best at its craft. The master and mistress of cheese, Elling Trias and Elaine Trias seem to be training young Ben Trias as an apprentice of cheese.

In life, Trevor was a priest of the Holy Light and friend to Leonid Barthalomew. He died and was risen as an undead during the Third War but was freed from the mindless servitude of the Lich King by Sylvanas Windrunner. In undeath he still wears priestly robes in almost tolerable condition and refuses to wield the shadow even if the Light abandoned him. One day he discovered a human in the Undercity and recognize him as being the famous paladin, Andarin Lightblade. Leading the chance Trevor proposed him a deal: Trevor wouldn't alarm the guards and Andarin would speak on Trevor's behalf with the Argent Dawn as accepting the priest in their ranks. The deal was made and while the paladin kept t
__NOTOC__ Trellis Morningsun is the Silvermoon quartermaster and can be found at the Sunreaver Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown as part of the Argent Tournament.

Trial of the Champion is a 5-player dungeon in the Crusaders' Coliseum. It involves three encounters, each of which rewards a Champion's Seal in Heroic mode. Start the event by speaking with Arelas Brightstar or Jaeren Sunsworn in the center of the coliseum once the party is mounted atop their Argent Warhorses. Every loot item which drops in both Normal and Heroic modes of this dungeon is of epic quality. The loot for Normal mode equals or surpasses 10-man Naxxramas drops in some slots. The loot for Heroic mode equals or surpasses 10-man Ulduar drops in some slots. Its difficulty should not be underestimated: Trial of the Champion is by no means a "get epics quick" scheme for under-geared pl

Triple-Reinforced Mining Bag is a 36-slot mining bag which can be crafted by leatherworkers with leatherworking (500). It is taught by Pattern: Triple-Reinforced Mining Bag, a reputation reward pattern that can be purchased from for upon completing the quest Filling the Moonwell.
Triple Snap is an ability used by scorpids, lizards and other pets during a Pet Battle.

The lost treasures hidden throughout Pandaria are items of great value, found in containers and NPCs throughout Pandaria (usually of the same name). Obtaining them is the objective of a series of achievements. There are 28 known containers/NPCs that contain lost treasures, although some of these will provide one of a number of possible items. Almost all lost treasures are rare gear items, while a few are other useful items such as recipes. The treasures of Pandaria are very similar, but count toward a separate set of achievements. Rather than providing a powerful item, many treasures grant poor quality items (most with sell prices of around ), while others simply grant gold upon interacting
Trihorn Charge is an ability used by direhorns during a Pet Battle.
Treasury Guards are Mag'har orcs found in the Valley of Strength during the Siege of Orgrimmar.

Tremblade's Vanguard is a subzone of Ashran, and the south-central Tower of the Road of Glory. To the north lie the open plains of The Crossroads, while to the south a curving path leads up to Archmage Overwatch. Situated directly in the shadow of the Overwatch, the Stormshield Tower Guardian Rylai Crestfall stands watch over the Vanguard, hurling bolts of summoned ice down upon the heads of any attackers foolish enough to stray within reach of her magic. The second Alliance Tower in the zone, all Alliance players within Tremblade's Vanguard gain a 10% increase to their healing and damage done.
Treble is a mechanical wolf that is found patrolling central Highmountain while invisible.

The Trial of Style is a biannual micro-event in which adventurers from around Azeroth put their best clothes on and amaze the other contestants with their superior style. Six contestants are required. The Trial of Style acts as a scenario for which you can queue up with other random players. Speak with a transmogrifier NPC in any major city to participate in the Trial.
The Trick Vest was sold for by Durkis and Zuna during Island Expeditions.
Tremorbeast Heart is an anima power obtained from the Anima Cell left behind afeter defeating the Dusky Tremorbeast in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tremorbeast Tusk is an anima power obtained from the Anima Cell left behind afeter defeating the Dusky Tremorbeast in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Trembling Earths are earth elementals found in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Treeflitters are flying squirrels located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

:This page is about trolls in general. For the playable races, see troll (playable), and Zandalari troll (playable). Trolls (also collectively referred to as trollkind) are a diverse sapient race that can be found in every part of Azeroth. They are one of the world's oldest known native races. Trolls are divided into many subgroups adapted to different environments, namely blood trolls, dark trolls, forest trolls, ice trolls, jungle trolls, sand trolls, and Zandalari trolls. Many trolls have no loyalty except amongst their own tribes, but some important groups have joined the Horde: the Darkspear tribe, Shatterspear tribe, Revantusk tribe, and Zandalari Empire. Some forest trolls cling to th

Troll Roof Stalkers were jungle troll guards found on top of the rooftops on the eastern edge of the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. They were stealthed, trap targets, and attacked with bows for around 2000 damage on cloth. They effectively prevented Alliance players hiding from there.
Trope the Filth-Belcher is a Broken quest giver located at the Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. He is friendly to players who have completed Blood Oath of the Netherwing.

Troll Witchery is an Alliance-only quest in which players are asked to collect instruments of troll magic from Skullsplitter spellcasters in Stranglethorn Vale. Brother Nimetz believes studying these instruments may explain the reason behind Colonel Kurzen's corruption.

Trixy Trixerton is a gnome trade supplier located in Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight. She is one of the inhabitants of Wintergarde Village saved by the player during Flight of the Wintergarde Defender; therefore, she can be found at the keep only after the completion of this quest.

__NOTOC__ Trizormu is a bronze dragon, in the guise of a gnome, trade goods vendor located in the Wyrmrest Temple in the Dragonblight. During Deathwing's final assault on the Temple, Trizormu was injured but soon healed by a Crimson Lifebinder. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, he was brutally interrogated by the Deathlord of the Ebon Blade about the whereabouts of Kyranastrasz and the Lost Glacier. While the bronze dragon gave a few details, he did not have what the Deathlord wants and instead directed them to the red dragonflight (specifically Tariolstrasz) to find the knowledge they seek.

Troll Archaeology Fragments are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Troll archaeology sites.

The Trolls of Lordaeron have suffered ages of attrition at the hands of the Humans, Dwarves, and Elves. The appearance of the Orcish Horde has given them the opportunity to ally themselves with kindred spirits with whom they can seek revenge upon their many enemies. More agile than the brutish Orcs, Trolls employ throwing axes - along with a cunning attack and retreat stratagem - to assail their foes. This combination of speed, range and the ability to bring down threats from above makes them a valuable addition to the Orcish Horde.

__NOTOC__ :"Say hello to my little friend!" -classic.battle.net entry Troll Warlords are troll axethrower creeps that can be encountered in many tilesets, with forest trolls, ice trolls and dark trolls appearing. They are the most powerful troll creeps in melee games.
Triumph War Gryphons are gryphons located at the Battlescar of Southern Barrens. Wildhammer Mercenaries fly them.
Triune Ward is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Troublesome Grips are a quest reward from Big Trouble in Moonbrook.

Troll Legends refers to multiple things. Which one do you mean? *The First Troll Legend: Moon over the Vale *The Second Troll Legend: Gri'lek the Wanderer *The Third Troll Legend: Fall of Gurubashi *The Fourth Troll Legend: The Emperor's Tomb

Truesilver is a metal that can be mined at level 205, although it can't be smelted until 230. Truesilver Deposits can also produce gems. Gems found in Truesilver Deposits include Aquamarine, Citrine, and Star Ruby. Truesilver Ore can be smelted into Truesilver Bars by miners. Interestingly, Truesilver has been noted to be a material that is both incredibly light and stronger than steel.
__NOTOC__ Tsunaman is a water elemental quest giver located at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. He was an agent of the Tribunal of the Tides, high-ranking servants of Neptulon.

The Truesilver Shafted Arrow item teaches the character the skill to summon and dismiss Peddlefeet, a winged, flying goblin companion. Though armed with a bow, Peddlefeet is a non-combat companion and will not aid you in battle.
Tunic of the Crescent Moon is a Level 48 quality Leather Tunic that improves Intellect, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Trusk is a jungle troll gladiator owned by Sparkeye. His arm was cut off by Lo'Gosh in battle, a wound which Sparkeye said could not be regenerated.
The True Power of the Tempest is created by collecting 3 Essence of the Storm (Sholazar Basin) and 3 Essence of the Monsoon and bringing them to the Shrine of the Tempest.

The Tunnel Rat group of kobolds are found at Silver Stream Mine. They and their dens can also be found west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside. Silver Stream Mine ran dry long ago, and it was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot. The Tunnel Rats moved in and the miners couldn't get their Miners' Gear out in time. They are members of the Axis of Awful.

The Trusty Copper Racer is sold by the following vendors for : * in Dalaran * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City * in Orgrimmar It can also be found inside the Stolen Present and Stolen Gift during Feast of Winter Veil.

This complex device is employed in the City of Ratchet whenever the Venture Company is making an important deal with a new supplier and wants ascertain whether or not the supplier is trustworthy. The creature being tested sits in a comfortable chair surrounded by an array of machinery, and is slowly and painstakingly connected to each and every one of them. Clamps on the end of caliper arms help measure the movement between brow and jaw, tight elastic bands measure the contraction of muscles in the forearm, glass tubes filled with mercury track changes in temperature and pressure near the ears, and membranes pressed up against the chest help record the sound of liquids moving in the stomach.
Trumpet Strike is an ability used by clefthooves, elephants and rhinos during a Pet Battle.

The True Horde (or the true Horde, Hellscream's Horde, and the Orcish Horde) is the organization formed by those members of the Horde who remained loyal to Garrosh Hellscream after Vol'jin led a rebellion against him. They are devoted to the conquest of Azeroth and orcish supremacy, and as such there are very few other races in it. It is the main antagonistic faction of the final story arc in Mists of Pandaria. After their defeat in Orgrimmar, they were led by Zaela and entered an alliance with Kairoz and the Infinite Dragonflight in order to free Garrosh from custody (or rather buy time in order to transport him to of the past). Many later joined the Iron Horde formed by .
Tungsten is a monkey located at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Trytooth Hardchisel is a Bluewax kobold found in Candle Rock in Highmountain during Candle of Command and Burn the Candle at Both Ends. According to Intern Jackie, Trytooth has a dull mind, but a sharp chisel. During Candle of Command, Trytooth is the second kobold to appear to be offered a job by the adventurer. During Burn the Candle at Both Ends, he is also the second to return, having killed the largest basilisk in the cavern in the form of the Catacomb Gazestomper. The adventurer rewards him by giving him a dusty boot to wear as a hat.
__NOTOC__ Tu'Las the Gifted is a Highmountain tauren located near Tactician Tinderfell in Trueshot Lodge after researching Unseen Path (advancement).
Tulha Treehorn is a Highmountain tauren located at Swiftwind Post in Drustvar.
Trueflight Fletchings drop from birds and other feathered creatures. When you loot it you gain a buff which grant your ranged attack a chance to inflict additional physical damage.
Tumat is a mogu of the Zian-Ti clan encountered in the Unknown Crypt during Island Expeditions.
Trousers of Peculiar Potency drop from Dark Inquisitor Xanesh in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Tumultuous Azerite is an Azerite elemental located in Island Expeditions.
Tumbling Technique is a conduit for monks. It drops from the Hungering Destroyer in Castle Nathria, Halkias in the Sanguine Depths, and the Eye of the Jailer in the Sanctum of Domination.
Tunnel-Keeper Ky'nyx is a beetle located in Island Expeditions.
Tsunami Relic is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tundrid Phial is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tumbling Rollstone is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tunic of Ashes are a quest reward from Ashes to Ashes (Stonetalon Mountains).
Tullek is a tuskarr located on Longclaw Island in the Azure Span. He is teaching the art of Fishing to the Longclaw Fish Catcher.

Tsegzaya was the first daughter of Teera, the first matriarch of the Maruuk centaur. She stepped up to lead and revitalize the centaur after her mother's death, but faced many hardships. She was encouraged by her friend Dihar, who knew that she was capable and compared her leadership qualities—heart, strength, and compassion—to a quiver of arrows that she could fire all at once to win the Maruuk over. Tsegzaya only laughed at this, but Dihar named her weapon—:Tsegzaya, the Brambled Bow—in her honor and used it to show her friend that she could fire many arrows at once with precision. Dihar didn't leave Tsegzaya's side until her own death. Although she is not identified with the title, Dihar'

The tuskarr (known as kalu'ak in their own language) are a peaceful humanoid -like people indigenous to the cold shores of Northrend and the Dragon Isles. They make their home along the coasts of the two continents, having settlements in Borean Tundra, Dragonblight and Howling Fjord in Northrend and the Waking Shores, the Azure Span, and the Forbidden Reach on the Dragon Isles. Most Northrend tuskarr are members of the Kalu'ak faction, while most of the Dragon Isles ones are affiliated with the Iskaara Tuskarr.
__NOTOC__ :"A Paladin's power - nay, his very presence in the Light is enough to cause even the most ravenous undead to flee."

Turtle Box is one of the possible rewards from the quests A Warden of the Alliance and A Warden of the Horde during the Children's Week seasonal event. It teaches the player to summon Speedy. It can also be seen in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City.
Tuurem is a former draenei city in Terokkar Forest's northern reaches.
Turning the Tide sends the player to the Shattered Halls to defeat Warchief Kargath Bladefist and retrieve his fist as proof.
Twiggy Flathead was a level 35 goblin found on Fray Island near the eastern coast of the Barrens. He has since gone missing.

__NOTOC__ Turtle Meat drops from turtles in Alterac Mountains, Azshara, Blackfathom Deeps, Dustwallow Marsh, Hillsbrad Foothills, Maraudon, Old Hillsbrad Foothills, Tanaris, The Hinterlands and Thousand Needles.

Turn Evil is a paladin class talent that causes the target to run in fear for up to 40 seconds. Only one target can be affected by the spell at any time. Turn Evil can only be used on Undead, Aberration and Demon targets. Note that despite functioning as a fear effect, Turn Evil is considered to 'turn' the target, and so is not prevented by abilities that prevent fear.

Turkeys are a species of bird. Usually, they can only be found in the Howling Fjord, though species appear in Elwynn Forest and Tirisfal Glades during Pilgrim's Bounty. Highlands Turkeys are capable of flying, unlike domesticated types.
Turida Coldwind is a tauren flight master located at Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. She can be found at the top of the Hold.

Twilight Aerie, located in Thousand Needles, sits atop the shelf above Highperch. It is guarded by flying Aerie Aces loyal to the Twilight's Hammer. Twilight Skymaster Richtofen leads the group that has invaded Highperching capturing and killing the wyvern.

Tushui Monks can be found protecting the Cave of Meditation, atop Balance Poles in the Singing Pools and on the docks of Morning Breeze Village on the Wandering Isle. Finally, some made their way to Stormwind City with Aysa Cloudsinger.
Turquoise Scarabs are beetles found in the Obelisk of the Stars-phased area during Harrison Jones quest in Uldum.
This tabard can be purchased for from at the pandaren camp in Stormwind City at reputation with Tushui Pandaren.
Tushui Satchel is a reputation reward; you must be with the Tushui Pandaren to purchase it from in Stormwind City for .
Tux Fizzlezikker is a goblin vendor that briefly appears in Garrosh'ar Advance and Mogujia in Kun-Lai Summit.
Turkina is a worgen fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. She died after the portal was destroyed.

The Turbulent Trinket will create one of the following rare trinkets, depending on your class and specialization. * Turbulent Emblem * Turbulent Focusing Crystal * Turbulent Relic of Mendacity * Turbulent Seal of Defiance * Turbulent Vial of Toxin

Twilber Torquewrench is a gnome mechanic at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. During Children's Week, he offers Rental Choppers for use during Cruisin' the Chasm. During the Legion Invasions, instead of fighting with the other defenders of the Hill, Twilber was flying above in his own gyrocopter instead.

Twelve-String Guitar is a toy that plays the theme of Tristram from the Diablo franchise. The town of Tristram, with a now-desecrated cathedral, was the center stage of events for . Tristram would later be destroyed in , followed up in with a new Tristram having been established near the ruins of the old. The guitar can be played at any inn. Using it anywhere else gives the error "You must be in an inn to strum that guitar."
Turalyon's Hope is a destroyer located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in .
Tushui Magisters are Tushui pandaren located in the Wizard's Sanctum of Stormwind City. They maintain a portal to Paw'don Village in Pandaria.
Turtle Eggs can be found on Island Expeditions. They heal adventurers for 10% of their max health.
Tuskbreaker the Scarred is a quilboar brute who can be encountered on Island Expeditions.
Turboris is an earth elemental located in a cave in the Slagmire in the Waking Shores. The elemental is sending waves of Shattered Fragments out to fight a pair of Qalashi Bonebreakers.
Turn Up the Heat is an ability that would be used during a Pet Battle.

The Twilight Shore is a stretch of coast in southern Darkshore. It lies south of the Long Wash, which ends due west of Ameth'Aran, and runs all the way south to Ashenvale. The Twilight Shore is the most rugged part of Darkshore's coast, and the gray beaches get broken up by jutting cliffs and small islands in the south. Murlocs are abundant here, and the waters bulge with aggressive threshadons who do not hesitate to attack adventurers swimming for shore. During the Battle for Darkshore, the Darkscale naga took advantage of the turmoil between the Alliance and Horde to invade the Twilight Shore.
Twilight Corrupter is satyr boss and part of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest line. He will spawn next to the moonwell in the back corner of Twilight Grove in Duskwood.
A location somewhere on Azeroth. This sunken island holds many perilous opportunities for adventurous parties to besiege and conquer their opponents.
Twilight Runners are saber cats found in the Stonetalon Mountains. At some point after the Cataclysm, a young twilight runner chased Aramar Thorne and Taryndrella.
Twilight Whiskers dropped from Twilight Runners in Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Disciples are located at Master's Glaive in Darkshore prior to the Shattering.

== In Outland == The Twilight Portal is one of the four dimensional gateways which Magtheridon used to bring demons from the Twisting Nether under his control. It is located on Twilight Ridge and is involved in the quest Disrupting the Twilight Portal in which you must attack Deathshadow agents. It is still intact but not functioning, so the Deathshadow are channeling magic into it in order to stabilize it. However, for the quest The Soul Cannon of Reth'hedron, upon defeating Reth'hedron the Subduer, he opens the Twilight Portal and quickly escapes through it vowing to one day return.
The Twilight Realm (also known as the Realm of Twilight and the Twilight Zone) is a plane used by members of the Twilight dragonflight. It is depicted with a purple hue.

The Twilight Terrace is a chunk of rock floating above the Masters' Gate area of Deepholm, far to the southwest of the Temple of Earth. It is from here that directs his members of the Twilight's Hammer clan as they prepare to enter the recently unearthed waygate to cross into Uldum. It is also from here that Haethan siphons the energies from the elementals imprisoned within the Twilight cult camp below, making himself increasingly powerful.

The Twilight Withering, to the east of Twilight Bulwark, is a similar outpost located on a shelf southeast of Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. It's here the Twilight's Hammer have summoned a monstrosity, an elemental infused with all four elements along with some Elementium. Known as Animus, this creature is absorbing two powerful elementals, Bound Fury and Bound Vortex. Using :The Doomstone, when it has absorbed enough energy from them it will explode taking Thousand Needles with it.

Twilight Highlands is the fifth and final level-up zone of World of Warcraft: Cataclysm, found on the east coast of Khaz Modan on the Eastern Kingdoms. The quest chain starts in either Stormwind or Orgrimmar and involves a short chain in the capital city before heading out to the highlands proper. The first half of the zone plays out in separate storylines for the Alliance and Horde, but once players reach the Maw of Madness, they share the storyline for the rest of the zone. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Fading into Twilight

Twilight Caverns is an area within the Bastion of Twilight where Sinestra resides. It becomes accessible only after defeating Cho'gall on Heroic mode. From here Sinestra creates the Twilight Dragonflight. It is deep beneath Grim Batol.

Twilight Lord Bathiel is a water ascendant boss found in the the Moonshrine Sanctum of Blackfathom Deeps. Serving a dark master, Bathiel took command of the Twilight's Hammer through his unbending will after the Cataclysm. His first order was to throw his sire, Twilight Lord Kelris, into the hungry maw of Aku'mai. In raising the hydra, Bathiel drew on the elements more than any shaman would dare to. He was killed by Horde champions, along with his cult members. After the Fourth War, Rexxar and Zekhan entered the Deeps in order to confirm that the Twilight's Hammer remained dead. Zekhan then reported that since his death, no other cultist seemed to have stepped in as leader.

Twilight Glade is a Rangari camp located within the Nightmarsh. It is a small draenei camp close to Shaz'gul. During the Shadowmoon storyline, adventurers are instructed by Velen to find out what the are up to and how to prevent it.

The Twilight Canticle is a book written by Cho'gall during the First War to codify teachings about the Void. As the ogre mage attuned himself to the Old Gods, he branded the prophecies of the Twilight's Hammer onto the skin of his Pale orc followers before cutting off their flesh to form the pages of the book. The Twilight Canticle would become a source of power and motivation for the followers of the Old Gods for decades.
Twilight Fire is an ability used by a cat and a dragon during a Pet Battle.
Twilight Strikers were humans located in Stormwind City appearing during Unholy Cow.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Shardkeepers are drogbar located in Deep Roads in Highmountain.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Orelifters are drogbar located in the Deep Roads in Highmountain.
Twilight Soul is a spectre located at the Terrace of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Twilight Dominators are shades found at the Ashen Lake in Mount Hyjal. They appear after destroying a Rod of Subjugation during Breaking the Bonds.
Twilight Glow is a Balance druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Dark Side of the Moon (druid artifact trait), Rapid Innervation and Sunfire Burns traits.

Twilight Skyterrors are twilight drakes located above the Twilight Citadel in the Twilight Highlands. Flying around, they are initially unattackable. Lirastrasza circles the area, dealing heavy damage to any in her path. As they fall to the ground, they become attackable.
Twilight Scalesworn are twilight dragonspawn located on expedition islands.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Juggernauts are twilight dragonspawn of the Twilight dragonflight located at Sethria's Roost in Mount Hyjal.
Twilight Express is an establishment located in Starcaller Retreat of Suramar City in Suramar.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Doomcaller is a twilight dragonspawn that can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Twilight Commanders are twilight dragonspawn located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Twilight Evolutionist is a dragonman located in Island Expeditions.
The Twilight Dragon's Armplates are an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Crestfall Salvage.
The Twilight Dragon's Breastplate is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Crestfall Salvage.
The Twilight Dragon's Crushers are an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Crestfall Salvage.
The Twilight Dragon's Greatbelt is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Crestfall Salvage.
The Twilight Dragon's Helm is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Crestfall Salvage.
The Twilight Dragon's Legplates are an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Crestfall Salvage.
The Twilight Dragon's Pauldrons are an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Crestfall Salvage.
The Twilight Dragon's Warboots are an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Crestfall Salvage.
Twilight Wilderlings are wilderlings flying above the area just northeast of the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald, stretching up to the southern Glitterfall Heights.

Twilight Strength is projected above an Arcane Devices in the Waking Shores. Another is located in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach. Interacting with the energy, grants Twilight Aegis for 15 minutes, granting 5% increase to all stats, at the cost of 10% max health.

__NOTOC__ Tyranastrasz (aka Tyrannistrasz or Tyran) was the first consort of the Dragonqueen Alexstrasza. He was ancient and wise, but also a very large powerful wyrm. He was known as "The Scholarly One" among the red dragons. Tyranastrasz was Alexstrasza's majordomo in all affairs.

__NOTOC__ Tymor is a dwarf quest giver located in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge. He is a student of the arcane magic and arts, and took interest in the history of the Azshara region. Xiggs Fuselighter owns him a favor or two.

Coastal fog has enshrouded this archipelago. Be wary as you pass from one island to the next: there is no telling what leviathans lie sleeping in this cold sea.[http://www.battle.net/war3/maps/war3xbonusmaps1.shtml]
The path twists, and the future is uncertain. Race for the center and the treasures it might hold, or visit a Goblin Laboratory and explore one of the small islands.
Two-Handed Axes and Maces was an 11-point Shaman talent in the Enhancement tree. Before it was removed in Patch 2.3, it granted shamans the ability to wield two-handed axes and two-handed maces.
Tyrael's Hilt summons an in-game companion angel, Mini Tyrael. He responds to emotes such as /dance, and was one of the first companions to fly.

Tyler is a Forsaken found in the War Quarter in the Undercity. Along with Edward, he fights against other NPCs summoned by Brother Malach: starting with three human captives, then a ghoul and a zombie, and at the end an abomination.

Tyr's Terrace is the terrace that runs along Utgarde Keep. At the end, Ingvar the Plunderer can be found. A non-instanced version of the terrace appears in the main Howling Fjord zone. It is accessible via a flying mount, and unlike the Utgarde Keep version, it is empty.
This item is crafted with Inscription, via the Darkmoon Card of the North recipe.

Two Forms is a racial ability available to worgen upon completion of Neither Human Nor Beast during the worgen starting experience which allows them to freely transform between their human and worgen forms while outside of combat. The transformation is purely cosmetic, and entering combat while in human form will automatically return the player to worgen form. The animation first shows the human's hands become clawed and their arms covered in fur before fully transforming.
Tympanic Tantrum is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
